name: overshoot each update by a fixed relaxation factor
mechanism: wherever an iteration would move a variable to a new value, move it further along the same direction by a fixed factor greater than one (or less than one to damp); the right factor can cut the number of sweeps by an order of magnitude

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Successive over-relaxation (SOR)' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra: method used to speed up convergence of the Gauss–Seidel method

fails_when: a factor at or beyond 2 diverges; the best factor is problem-dependent
